format: Gym Challenge (G2, 2000): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only. 17-20 are the holo Blaine, Giovanni, Koga and Sabrina; 15, 69 and 93 are prints of Celebrations, 30th Celebration and Wizards promo cards; 127-132 are the basic Energy.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Roaring Flames
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. If all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon provide 2 Fire Energy, discard all of them. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Flame Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach an Evolution card from your hand to this Pokémon. (This doesn't count as evolving this Pokémon.) Treat this Pokémon as if it were that Pokémon instead. It can't evolve, devolve, or use the Pokémon Power of that Pokémon. During your turn, you may discard the Evolution card attached to this Pokémon. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If this Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, discard all Evolution cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wide Solarbeam

attacks.name: Summon Storm
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage to each other Pokémon (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fortitude

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack

cards.name: Blaine
cards.text: This turn, instead of attaching 1 Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, you may attach 2 Fire Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing more than 1 Blaine in a turn has no extra effect.)

cards.name: Brock's Protection
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon with Brock in its name. Your opponent's attacks and Trainer cards can't remove the Energy cards attached to that Pokémon. (The rest of the attack or Trainer card still happens.)

cards.name: Chaos Gym
cards.text: Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, they flip a coin. If heads, the card works normally. If tails, they can't play it, and their opponent may use it instead (if they can do everything needed to play it, such as discarding cards). Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile.

cards.name: Erika's Kindness
cards.text: Remove 2 damage counters (or 1 if it has only 1) from each Pokémon in play, yours and your opponent's, that has damage counters on it.

cards.name: Giovanni
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. This turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played it or it was just evolved, or if it's your first turn. (This also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.)

cards.name: Giovanni's Last Resort
cards.text: Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

cards.name: Koga
cards.text: This turn, whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Koga in its name attacks and does damage to the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned (after the damage).

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan
cards.text: Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench (not if your Bench is full). It's a Basic Pokémon while it's face down. Flip it over if either player needs to know what it is to use an attack, a Pokémon Power or a Trainer card, and when it uses an attack or Pokémon Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack or is otherwise affected by an attack. You may flip it over at any time during your turn. When it's flipped over, if it isn't a Basic Pokémon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

cards.name: Misty's Wish
cards.text: Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Ask your opponent whether you may switch it with a card from your hand. If they say yes and you have other cards in your hand, switch them. If they say no, put the Prize card back face down and draw a card.

cards.name: Resistance Gym
cards.text: Each Pokémon's Resistance is 20 less.

cards.name: Sabrina
cards.text: Move all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to another of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #2
cards.text: Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it's an Energy card, a Trainer card or a Pokémon card. If they guess right, they draw 2 cards; if not, you draw 2 cards. Then put that card back into your hand.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #3
cards.text: Put a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of 1 of its attacks. Your opponent guesses the card's name. If they guess right, they draw 3 cards; if not, you draw 3 cards. Then put that card back into your hand.

cards.name: Cinnabar City Gym
cards.text: Whenever a Water Pokémon does damage to a Pokémon with Blaine in its name, ignore Weakness.

cards.name: Fuchsia City Gym
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, they may shuffle 1 of their Pokémon in play with Koga in its name, and all cards attached to it, into their deck.

cards.name: Koga's Ninja Trick
cards.text: Attach this card to your Active Pokémon with Koga in its name. If that Pokémon moves to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon before the attack's damage and effects.

cards.name: Master Ball
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may show your opponent a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the other cards back and shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Max Revive
cards.text: Put a Pokémon card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.name: Misty's Tears
cards.text: Discard 1 of the other cards from your hand to search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
cards.text: Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokémon onto their Bench from their hand, they flip a coin. If tails, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card, put it into your hand and shuffle your deck. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put into play (not a Stadium or Pokémon Tool) and use it as if you had played it from your hand. It stays in your opponent's discard pile.

cards.name: Saffron City Gym
cards.text: As often as they like during their turn (before attacking), each player may return a basic Energy card attached to 1 of their Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to their hand.

cards.name: Viridian City Gym
cards.text: Whenever a player evolves 1 of their Pokémon with Giovanni in its name, they remove 2 damage counters from it (or 1 if it has only 1).

cards.name: Fervor
cards.text: Show your opponent the top 3 cards of your deck. Put any Fire Energy cards among them into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Transparent Walls
cards.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.name: Warp Point
cards.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with their Active Pokémon. Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with your Active Pokémon.
